tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las drag po'i sku/ /bstan dang de 'dzin skyong zhing bdud dpung 'joms/ /sgrub la mchog stsol ma hā kā la dang / /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla mas dge legs stsol/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom tshul la/ skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa ni/ gnas khang srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang / rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi ro gdan la bla ma nag po chen po sprul pa'i pho nya lnga bcas pa'i sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la/ bdag dang ma gyur sems can thams cad 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ ngag tu/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma la/ /skyabs su mchi'o bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /long skabs dang bstun pas tshar ci rigs brjod pas/ bla ma gur mgon kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sku gnyis kyi sangs rgyas su gyur nas so so'i gnas su gshegs/ bla ma nag po chen po 'od sngon tshul gyis rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ sems bskyed ni thal sbyar/ ngag tu/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can don slad du/ /bdag gis zung 'jug dpal ldan he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang thob phyir rdo rje theg pa'i bcud/ /zab mo bla ma'i rnam 'byor bsgom par bgyi/ /lan ci rigs/ dngos gzhi ni/ ngag tu/ rang bzhin rnam dag stong nyid 'od gsal dang /

/rab 'jigs bsrung ba'i 'khor los bskor ba'i gzhir/ /zhing mchog rnam dag pho brang chen po'i dbus/ /seng khri pad nyi mi ro'i gdan stengs su/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus gdan gsum tshang ba'i dngos/ /he ru ka dpal dpal ldan nag po che/ /bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma de/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'od phung rab tu 'bar/ /dran pas byin rlabs bdud las rnam rgyal ba/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mi thung gel ba'i gzugs/ /gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍe'i phyag mtshan can/ /dar nag lhab lhub stag shams rus rgyan 'chang / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /pho nya lnga bcas bdag la dges bzhin bzhugs/ /gang de'i sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /skad cig nyid la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho bla ma'i sku la thim/ /'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /grub stsol yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bka' srung rnams kyi mnga' bdag bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni thal sbyar/ ngag tu/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byur ba'i gzhi/ /nyon mongs kyis bsags zas nor longs spyod kun/ /bla ma nag po che la mchod par 'bul/ /rgyags dang ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi zhe sdang rang gzugs shar ba yi/ /gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ci mchis pa/ /bla ma nag po chen po'i 'khor du 'bul/ /zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar༞ /ltar snang phan pa'i 'khor bar 'ching ba'i grogs/ /gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa/ /bla ma nag po chen po'i༞ /'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar༞ /tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang / /las nyon dbang gis da dung ngo ma shes/ /bar ma'i 'gro rnams nag po chen por 'bul/

/gti mug phrag dog zhi bar༞ /rang lus tha mal phung po nyes kun gzhi/ /ye shes ral gri rno ngar ldan pa yis/ /thod pa bcad nas snod du byas pa'i nang / /rkang pa nas brtsams yan lag lhur phral nas/ /dum bur gtub cing thod pa'i nang bcug la/ /rang sems rlung dang dbyer med he ru kas/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur ba 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du kha raṃ khā hī/ /yi dam zhi khro'i zhal du༞ /rgyal ba sras bcas zhal du༞ /chos srung nor lha'i zhal du༞ /rigs drug lhar gsal zhal du༞ /lan chags lhar gsal zhal du༞ /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma snod bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub pa 'di/ /ma lus bla ma nag po che la 'bul/ /bdag la dges pas myur du bzhes nas kyang / /bde chen ye shes da lta nyid du stsol/ /de gsol ba btab pa'i sgo nas dngos grub zhu ba ni/ gang gi 'phrin las lhan skyes bde ba che/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /bdag gi snying gi pad+mo kha 'byed pa'i/ /bka' drin 'khor med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kun 'dus shing / /zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun gyi rje/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug he ru ka /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mthong bas tha mal rnam rtog 'gags/ /gang gsung thos pas snying la bde chen ster/ /gang thugs dran pas srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyobs/ /'brel tshad don ldan zhabs la༞ /dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman ci byung yang / /mgon khyod ma gtogs skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /brtse chen thugs rjes bdag la myur du gzigs/ /cir snang snod bcud bla ma'i skur shes shing / /sgra rnams grags stong rdo rje'i gsung du shar/ /sems nyid chos sku bde chen khyed thugs dang / /nam yang 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog

/gnas skabs tshe bsod longs spyod 'khor 'bangs rgyas/ /gnod sems mi dang mi min 'gro ba kun/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis rang gzhan la/ /gnod bral phan sgrub lhag bsam 'phel bar shog /bdag gi lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs ji snyed rje btsun khyed la 'bul/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin rgyur gyur nas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs ma lus bsgrub par shog /nam zhig rje btsun rdo rje 'chang dbang khyod/ /gang du bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams der/ /'khor du skyes nas bka' bzhin bsgub pa dang / /gsang chen bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis 'tsho bar shog /de ltar gsol bas bla ma nag po che/ /dges shing 'dzum pas 'od stong phung por zhu/ /bdag la brtser dgongs spyi bo'i gtsug nas thim/ /rang sems ngang du dbyer med ro gcig 'dres/ /gsal dwangs snang ba ma 'gags bla ma'i sku/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba bla ma'i gsung / /zung 'jug brjod bral blo 'das bla ma'i thugs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang / /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gyur/ /zhes brjod cing de kho na nyid kyi ngang la blo bzhag pa ni bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ lus bsam gtan gyis spyod lam la bsgrims/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag sems khong lhod la 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dun mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa la bzo bcos med par sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa/ gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gags pa/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i gsal le hrig ge stong nge ba'i ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag go /rjes bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa ni/ ngag tu/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/

/rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas skye bo kun/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du/ /lus ngag yid gsum yon tan rgya mtsho yis/ /dpal ldan bla ma rtag tu mchod par shog /khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /chos mthun 'byor pas tshe ring gnas pa dang / /byang chub sems mchog rim gnyis rnal 'byor sogs/ /rtse gcig zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom pa la/ /bar chad med cing mthun rkyen rgyas par shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ me srong ba'i sde pa ngag dbang kun phan dam chos rgyal mtshan gyi zhal 'don du gur zhal la brten pa'i gsang spyod zhig dgos zhes bskul ma gnang ba mgon po 'di la brten pa'i gsang spyod dmigs bsal yig cha gang na'ang med pas rang gi blos gya tshoms su bcos bslad ga la nus/ 'on kyang brag rdzong ma'i khams gsum g.yul du bcad pa'i skabs su/ 'khor los bcad pa dang chos nyid kyis bcad pa gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma 'di las zab pa'i gsang spyod ci la dgos/ las dang po pa rnams la dgra gnyen bar ma rang lus dang bcas pa'i zhen pa spang ba sngon 'gro'i bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi thugs rang sems rnams dbyer med du bsres pa'i lta ba la blo 'jog pa 'di gsang spyod kun gyi yang rtse yin par bsams te sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bskul ba po'i bzhed pa bskang ba'i phyir tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mgon po la brten pa'i bla ma mchod chog dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod gzhir bzhag kha bskong dgos pa rnams thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lam zab tshigs bcad ma dang /

rang gi blo gros kyis kyang dpyad de legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang gi nyer gnas bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / slad kyi yi ge pa kun dga' phun tshogs kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gur gyi mgon po'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
